internet.title: Internet
internet.subtitle: The gateway to the world and the starting point of security
features: Stable integration with external public cloud infrastructure
Secured bandwidth and optimized packet routing
Connection to the global internet backbone and traffic interworking

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.subtitle: Next-generation firewall that responds to evolving cyber threats
features: Real-time blocking of external threats and abnormal traffic
Precise intrusion detection powered by an IPS engine
Accurate packet filtering based on L4-L7 session state
effects: Policy control at the application/user level
Proactive response to the latest cyberattacks and unauthorized traffic
Unified perimeter security monitoring for maximum operational efficiency

ips.title: IPS (Intrusion Prevention System)
ips.subtitle: In-depth packet analysis and defense for the network
features: Real-time blocking of zero-day attacks and targeted exploits
Real-time updates of the latest global threat signatures
Deep packet inspection (DPI) via in-line deployment

vpn.title: VPN (Virtual Private Network)
vpn.subtitle: Ultra-secure remote transmission network based on tunneling technology
features: Robust AES-256 bit data encryption design
Device/user verification with multi-factor authentication (MFA)
Efficient data transmission via split tunneling
effects: Secure access to the internal network for remote/work-from-home environments
Granular session control based on individual user access rights

network.title: Network (Switching & Segmentation)
network.subtitle: Internal network securely restructured with high-speed switching and physical network segmentation
features: Zero-latency, high-speed internal communication via L2/L3 switching
Complete separation of business/security networks via VLANs and physical segmentation
Communication between segmented networks allowed only through controlled paths
effects: Eliminates the risk of malware spreading between business and security networks
Full compliance with legal/regulatory network segmentation standards

server.title: Secure Server Zone
server.subtitle: A secure repository for data assets and business applications
features: Encryption and full isolation of core databases
Strict control of unauthorized communication based on network segmentation
An integrated hub for NAC, DAC, DRM, DLP, and EDR security solutions

nac.title: NAC (Network Access Control)
nac.subtitle: Connects only authorized users and devices
features: Network access control based on user/device identity
Real-time inspection of security status (antivirus, patches, etc.) before and after connection
Automatic detection and isolation of unauthorized devices based on IP/MAC
effects: Completely blocks unauthorized device access
Ensures compliance with internal security policy and automates management
Achieves 100% visibility into all devices connected to the network

dac.title: DAC (Database Access Control)
dac.subtitle: Database security that controls and protects access to critical data
features: Control of DB access rights and SQL execution
Sensitive data masking with real-time control and alerts
100% logging and auditing of login accounts and query history
effects: Prevents unauthorized access to and tampering of core databases
Full compliance with financial/public sector regulations via SQL audit trails
Prevents personal data leaks and misuse by insiders

drm.title: DRM (Document Encryption)
drm.subtitle: Document security that protects files from creation to disposal
features: Automatic encryption of important documents with permission-based access control
Real-time tracking of document usage history (viewing, editing, printing)
Separate approval process and expiration settings for external document transfer
effects: Documents remain unreadable even if leaked externally
Minimizes insider leaks through capture/print/copy prevention (linked with DLP)
Maintains security in collaborative environments through document-level permissions

dlp.title: DLP (Data Loss Prevention)
dlp.subtitle: Prevents the leakage of sensitive information in advance
features: Real-time control of critical data leakage paths
Policy enforcement by medium, including USB, external drives, email, and messengers
Automatic detection and blocking of personal data and confidential keywords
effects: Prevents the illegal leakage of confidential corporate and personal information
Completely controls the use of unauthorized external storage devices
Secures post-incident audit trails and evidence by tracking leak attempts

edr.title: EDR (Endpoint Detection & Response)
edr.subtitle: Detects endpoint threats in real time and responds swiftly
features: Real-time detection and response to endpoint threats
Behavior-based analysis of ransomware and malware
Tracing attack entry paths through endpoint timeline analysis
effects: Early detection and blocking of unknown ransomware variants and emerging threats
Immediate isolation of affected devices in the event of a security incident
Reduced mean time to respond (MTTR) through root-cause analysis of breaches

ecm.title: ECM (Enterprise Content Management)
ecm.subtitle: Manages corporate documents centrally, securely, and efficiently
features: Centralized storage and integrated management of corporate documents
Protects document assets by blocking local storage
Supports document version control and recovery of previous states
effects: Prevents ransomware damage and data loss
Boosts collaboration productivity through efficient document sharing across teams and projects
Systematically preserves all intellectual assets with centralized, integrated security

client.title: Secure User PC
client.subtitle: The final end-user device used by on-site staff
features: Blocks malicious distribution sites using virtual web isolation
Enforces mandatory synchronization of NAC, DLP, DRM, and EDR agents
Automated management of vulnerability patches and OS security settings

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: MOOSOL Co., Ltd. values the privacy of its users and complies with the Personal Information Protection Act, the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, and other applicable laws.
privacy.a1Desc: The Company collects the minimum personal information necessary for the following purposes and does not use it for any other purpose.
a1List: Receiving applications for security assessments and solution consulting
Responding to consultation requests and arranging contact from the assigned engineer
Handling service inquiries and responding with results
privacy.a2Desc: The Company collects the following personal information for consultation requests and service inquiries.
privacy.a2Items: Name, email address, phone number, company name, and notes/inquiry details
privacy.a3Title: Article 3 (Retention and Use Period of Personal Information)
privacy.a3Desc: As a general rule, the Company destroys personal information without delay once the purpose of its collection and use has been achieved. However, where retention is required by applicable laws, the information is kept for a specified period.
privacy.a3Item1Desc: Retained for 1 year after the consultation is completed (deleted immediately upon the customer's request)
privacy.a3Item2Desc: Records related to consumer complaints or dispute resolution (3 years)
privacy.a4Title: Article 4 (Procedures and Methods for Destroying Personal Information)
privacy.a4Desc: Once the purpose of processing personal information has been achieved, the information is destroyed without delay.
privacy.a4Item1Desc: Destroyed using technical methods that prevent the records from being reproduced
privacy.a5Title: Article 5 (Personal Information Protection Officer and Manager)
privacy.a5Desc: For any inquiries related to personal information that may arise when submitting a consultation request, please contact the Personal Information Protection Officer below.
privacy.a6Desc: If you need to report or consult about any other infringement of your personal information, please contact the organizations below.
a6List: Personal Information Infringement Report Center (privacy.kisa.or.kr / Tel. 118, no area code)
Supreme Prosecutors' Office, Cyber Investigation Division (www.spo.go.kr / Tel. 1301, no area code)
National Police Agency Cyber Crime Report System (ecrm.police.go.kr / Tel. 182, no area code)
